description: Ministry of Labour, Trade Union Relations - The Award made to the Industrial Disputes between Mr. R. S. Weeratunga and Sri Lanka Airlines Limited (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content publishes an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which constitutes a legal/regulatory matter. It involves the formal publication of a legal decision made through statutory arbitration procedures, referencing specific sections of the Industrial Disputes Act (Chapter 131) and its amendments. The content focuses on the legal resolution of an industrial dispute between an individual and a company, making it a regulatory matter rather than a government personnel, organizational, or specialized administrative matter.
